tab.introBody: Drug companies and nonprofits run programs that may give this medicine for free or at low cost. Only the program can decide who it helps.
tab.found_one: {{count}} program may help with this medicine
tab.found_other: {{count}} programs may help with this medicine
tab.likelyExplain: “May fit” means all three: your whole income range is under the limit, your coverage fits, and it's open to new people. Only the program can decide.
tab.worthExplain: Something doesn't match yet, or the program doesn't publish its rules. A phone call can clear it up.
tab.closedTitle: Not taking new people right now
tab.closedExplain: We show these so you know they exist. Call to ask if they open again.

tab.emptyGeneric: Most generic medicines don't have a drug company help program. The Buy-now price may be your best option.

tab.staleTitle: Some program details may be out of date

tab.profileTitle: Add your household and income to see which programs fit

tracker.title: Your applications
tracker.intro: Keep each program in one place: documents, notes, and when to renew.
tracker.emptyBody: When you find a program that may help, tap “Track this application”. Your documents, notes and dates will stay together here.
tracker.acceptedNote: Wonderful! Ask how refills work, and set a reminder to renew.
tracker.deniedNote: A “no” is not always the end. Call and ask why, and if you can send more papers or apply again. You can also check other programs.
tracker.renewSuggested_one: Suggested: {{count}} month from today, this program's usual term. Change it to match your letter.
tracker.renewSuggested_other: Suggested: {{count}} months from today, this program's usual term. Change it to match your letter.
tracker.renewUnknownTerm: This program doesn't list how long help lasts. Ask when you call, then set the date here.
tracker.calendarFailed: Nothing was added to your calendar.
tracker.reminderFailed: We couldn't set a reminder. Check that RxBridge may send notifications in your phone's settings.
tracker.reminderPast: Pick a date in the future first.
tracker.webNote: Reminders and calendar events work in the phone app. In a web browser, please write this date down.
